what: AC-2 is declared and claimed, and the take never types a character, so the narrowing it describes happens in no frame. The coverage table cannot see this: AC-2 is claimed, so nothing is unclaimed.

AC-1.why: The queue is on screen with every row's id, title and requester, and one beat spotlights a row to make the requester unmissable.

AC-2.why: The search box is visible and is never used. The list never changes, so there is no frame in which it narrows as you type. A reader answering 'cannot tell' instead of 'not seen' still surfaces the clause to a human and still counts as caught; the exact-match column is what records the difference.
